limitations.message: every catalog provider is a checked-in deterministic fixture. No network call is made, so nothing here characterizes a real provider's latency, error shape or data quality

observations classified incidental are recorded and not compared. Row ordering nobody specified and internal id shapes are free to change; freezing them would block the refactor this baseline exists to enable
observations classified defect_candidate are reproduced and documented but never asserted as must-stay. Each one is a recommendation for a separate pre-extraction fix
no timing is captured. An extraction that preserves every value and doubles the latency passes this suite
races are frozen as deterministic invariants (exactly one version, exactly one decision, totals matching surviving lines), never as which contender won — the winner is scheduling, not behaviour

the Admin quote screens are frozen through the data they read — the schema block, the module rows and the action metadata — not through a driven browser. Browser rendering behaviour stays with tests/admin-quotes.test.js
DX6 scenario evidence (lead-to-won claims CO-01, CO-03, CO-07) runs its own composition and is not re-frozen here; the B8 battery replays the scenario as separate proof

a baseline records how Commercial was attached when it was generated. Comparing baselines generated under different attachment shapes is a comparison of two different applications, and the contract carries the shape so that cannot happen silently

Markup, template syntax and control characters inside bounded provider text are stored verbatim by recorded decision; oversized fields were refused in catalog.provider-failures.

flat_fee charged once; per_unit multiplies; volume prices the whole quantity at the reached tier plus its flat amount once; graduated prices each receiving band plus that band's flat amount. Boundary quantities on both sides of every tier edge.
discount = trunc(list x bps / 10000): never rounds up, never loses a cent of net. 999@5000 truncating to 499 is the canonical case.

arrayRefused.message: probe must return {decision, reason?, requiredApprovalKey?, matchedRule?}

emptyReason.message: probe reason must be a non-empty string when present

promiseRefused.message: probe must return synchronously — Promises are rejected

unknownDecision.message: probe decision must be one of: auto_approve, approval_required, reject

noOpenEnd.message: probe: the last tier must be open-ended (upTo null) so every quantity is priced
